scope: Coupled radius-two sphere densities verify exponential and signed derivative identities, including refined first-moment bounds. Finite-dimensional matrices check Gram, Bessel, Schur, inverse and full residual formulas. Original regulator constants and tent integrals are evaluated independently. These diagnostics do not supply original Yang-Mills vacuum or spectral values.
